articles.title: A dozen stocks, including PSU names SAIL, IREDA, Power Grid, Mazagon Dock and ONGC, to remain in focus on Monday
articles.summary: Indian PSU SAIL and Indonesia's PT Krakatau Steel are exploring a joint venture to establish a substantial stainless steel project. Following an MoU, the partnership aims for a capacity between 500,000 to 1 million tonnes. This strategic industrial collaboration highlights India's growing economic ties and manufacturing ambitions through international partnerships, contributing significantly to national industrial growth and resource optimization for future needs.

articles.title: Rosie O'Donnell reveals bittersweet details of recent visit to incarcerated daughter in federal prison
articles.summary: Celebrity Rosie O'Donnell recently spoke about her visit to a federal prison to see her 28-year-old daughter, Chelsea. O'Donnell revealed this marked their first 'proper' conversation, offering a glimpse into their relationship amidst Chelsea's incarceration. The account highlights a significant personal event for the talk show host, reflecting on the emotional reunion within the prison setting.

articles.title: Fargo wrestling USA championship brackets, results, Day 3 live updates
articles.summary: The three-day 16U and Junior Freestyle National Championships concluded on June 12 at North Dakota State University's FargoDome.
